class discord_http.enums.BaseEnum(new_class_name, /, names, *, module=None, qualname=None, type=None, start=1, boundary=None)¶

Bases: Enum

Enum, but with more comparison operators to make life easier.

This allows you to compare enums with their values or names directly, example:

IntegrationType.guild == 0  # True
IntegrationType.guild == "guild"  # True
IntegrationType.guild > 0  # False
IntegrationType.guild < "huh"  # True (because "guild" < "huh")

Honestly.. I just wanted it to be more convenient to compare enums without having to convert them first, lol.

property pretty_name: str¶

A prettified version of the enum name.
